Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`), and the service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried and confirmed it was created.)

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production release.
